column1: # LISTCOL is the 0-based column of the bit as printed in the listing (0 = leftmost).
# SCHBIT is the bit number used by the schematics and EK-KD11B-MM-001.
# The listing prints SCHBIT 39 leftmost and SCHBIT 0 rightmost: SCHBIT = 39 - LISTCOL.
# ACTIVE is the signal polarity from its name: L = asserted low, H = asserted high.
# PROM_E / PROM_F are the DEC part numbers of the PROM holding that bit; CHANGED marks
# the two slices that differ between board revision E (1973) and F (1976).
